question: May Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 be downloaded and built locally beside the retained Quantum ESPRESSO 7.2 installation, without running a scientific calculation?

options.consequence: Download the official QEF/q-e qe-7.5 tag, build it in a dedicated external QE 7.5 tree with the existing local toolchain, retain executable identities and build metadata, and leave the QE 7.2 tree unchanged.
Make no dependency installation and continue binding executable-specific behavior to the retained 7.2 build.

recommendation: Option A, because new input-file development is intended to target the current QE 7.5 contract while QE 7.2 remains available for reproduction.
blocked_scope: Downloading, configuring, and compiling Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5.
safe_scope: Read-only inspection of the existing QE 7.2 build, official QE 7.5 source metadata, and local toolchain.
normalized_decision: Option A approved: install and build Quantum ESPRESSO 7.5 side-by-side with the retained QE 7.2 tree, without running a scientific calculation.
authorized_scope: Download the official QEF/q-e qe-7.5 source tag; configure and compile it locally in a dedicated external QE 7.5 tree using the existing installed toolchain; inspect version banners and executable identities without a scientific input; retain build logs and report source, toolchain, binary roles, formats, sizes, and SHA-256 values. Do not overwrite QE 7.2, run a scientific calculation, change pseudopotentials or scientific settings, publish, release, or transmit project calculation data.
